title: Early learning in large residual networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.31783v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the early training dynamics of nonlinear residual networks with blocks of zero hidden layers as a model of more general residual networks. We analyze networks in a sequential limit where first width and depth diverge, then the number of training data points diverges, and finally the input dimension diverges. This is a more refined setup compared to the typical mean-field theory analysis in which depth and width diverge but the number of training datapoints and input dimension are fixed. Our main technical result is a diagrammatic computation of both the network output and the hidden representations after the few steps of gradient descent in terms of the statistics of inner products of inputs from the training set. translated_title: 大型残差网络中的早期学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由零隐藏层块构成的非线性残差网络的早期训练动态，并将其作为更一般残差网络的模型。我们在一个顺序极限下分析网络：首先让宽度和深度发散，然后让训练数据点数量发散，最后让输入维度发散。与典型的平均场理论分析（其中深度和宽度发散，但训练数据点数量和输入维度保持固定）相比，这是一个更精细的设置。我们的主要技术成果是一种图表计算方法，用训练集中输入内积的统计量来刻画梯度下降几步之后的网络输出和隐藏表示。我们的一个主要概念性发现是一个负面结果：在大输入维度极限下，网络输出在训练早期只能学习其输入的线性函数，因为更高阶的学习单项式……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过图表计算方法分析了大型残差网络在早期训练阶段的动态，发现在大输入维度极限下，网络在训练初期只能学习到输入的线性函数，无法学习更高阶的单项式。
en_tdlr: This paper uses diagrammatic computations to analyze the early training dynamics of large residual networks, finding that in the limit of large input dimension, the network output can only learn a linear function of its inputs early in training, as higher-order learned monomials cannot emerge.
